[[File:SebulbaGellaTwinMassage-TPM.png|thumb|right|250px|Sebulba receives a massage from the Gella twins prior to the Boonta Eve Classic.]]
'''''Yobana''''' was a [[Twi'leki/Legends|Twi'leki]] word that loosely translated as "masseuse." The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] twins [[Ann Gella/Legends|Ann]] and [[Tann Gella/Legends|Tann Gella]] were [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] beings who served in this capacity for their master, the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|podracer]] [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]].<ref name="New Essential Guide">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> Prior to racing in the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]], Tann and Ann provided Sebulba with a massage.<ref name="Episode I">{{Film|I}}</ref>
